author.name: Horace Chan
author.headline: Expert in applying AI in verification

text:
4 levels of AI adoption 

1. AI dinosaur - refuse to use AI

2. AI assisted - ask AI questions, but you still do most of the typing

3. AI native - let AI do all typing for you, but you still review its work

4. AI displaced - you outsource your thinking to AI too.  AI doesn't need your inputs anymore.
